preconditions: this points to a valid per-car render-state object; this+0x0 holds a pointer to the embedded render object dereferenced at obj+0x48BC (mode-selection flags), obj+0x4894 (team/manufacturer id) and obj+0xC4 (audio playback byte).
this+0x964 must be writable (the resolved render mode is stored there).
When the active-widget flag this+0x4 is set, globals dword_7C54F0 / dword_7C54E4 must reference a valid current vehicle for the team-id comparison at obj+0x4894.
a2 (render mode override) is only meaningful when bit 1 of the mode-selection flags word obj+0x48BC is set; otherwise a2 is ignored and the mode defaults to 3.
When the player branch is taken (dword_7C54E0 == this+0x0), the session-phase global dword_5EA510 must be valid because SessionPhaseDecode reads it.

Widget-flag fields this+0x144 .. this+0x8A0 are shown/hidden per the dispatched mode via FlagFieldBitManipulation; the 8-entry widget array at this+0x66C (stride 0x44) is processed gated on its +0x40/+0x41 gate bytes.

For the modes 1/2/3 tail and the mode-0 player session-phase branch, the audio enable transition StateHandlerDispatch(1) is dispatched when the state-dispatch gate v9 holds and the audio byte obj+0xC4 != 1; the mode-0 non-player/default path dispatches StateHandlerDispatch(0) when v9 holds and obj+0xC4 != 0.
Returns the last gate/flag-operation result in the low byte: the driver-model-visible byte this+0x96D, a FlagFieldBitManipulation outcome, or the gate v9.

Calls UIWidgetRecursiveStateUpdate (0x0054C1B0) with a team-matched threshold from dword_7CF860 to recursively update widget state.
Calls StateHandlerDispatch (0x004F7010) with argument 1 (enable) or 0 (disable) for audio state transitions.
